notes.title: The Hotel Renovations Update
notes.content:
Hi, the goal of this update is to fix known issues while also introducing new anomalies and achievements

The update features the following:

New Anomalies
New Achievements
More Room Decorations
New Menus
Bug Fixes
Optimization


Some of the original anomalies has also been changed or removed to make the game more fair
